reason: The plugin is primarily a local voice input tool for the DeepSeek Harness desktop chat composer, enabling microphone recording and offline transcription into message drafts. Evidence in the README clearly shows user-facing audio capture, keyboard-triggered recording, and transcript insertion, which aligns with media/input functionality rather than code, search, or collaboration features.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Composer 增加本地语音输入能力，可通过麦克风按钮或快捷键录音，并使用离线模型转写后将文本写入草稿。
summaries.en: This plugin adds local voice input to DeepSeek Harness Composer with a microphone button or shortcut, records audio, performs offline transcription, and inserts the result into the draft.

capabilities: Local microphone audio capture for recording user speech
Shortcut- and button-based control of recording start/stop
Local offline speech-to-text transcription via Parakeet model
Inserts transcript text into DeepSeek Harness composer draft

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a local microphone button in the DeepSeek Harness composer and supports Ctrl/Cmd+E shortcuts to start and stop recording.
README documents that the offline model receives a local WAV file and returns a final transcript inserted into the draft, with sending kept as a separate user action.
README and repository description describe the plugin as local, offline voice input for DeepSeek Harness using Parakeet/NeMo-Speech.

capabilities: Local microphone audio capture for recording user speech
Shortcut- and button-based control of recording start/stop
Local offline speech-to-text transcription via Parakeet model
Inserts transcript text into DeepSeek Harness composer draft
